title: MTF 对齐 reindex+ffill 缺 shift(1)，潜在 0.20 ROC-AUC look-ahead 虚高
description: mtf_aligner.py:177 用 df.reindex(aligned_index).ffill() 实现高时间框架下采样，注释自称「ffill 确保无未来数据泄漏」，但 ffill ≠ shift(1)。若高时间框架 bar 以 bar-open 时间戳索引，reindex+ffill 会让该 bar 的值在 bar 开始即对低时间框架可见，而非 bar 收盘后。MDPI Risks 8(3)40 论文指出此偏差使 ROC-AUC 虚高约 0.20（0.60→0.80），且据作者所知文献中未被显式讨论。应先核实 fetcher OHLCV 时间戳语义（bar-open vs bar-close），若为 bar-open 则需在 as-of merge 前对高时间框架时间戳 shift(1)。
fix_direction: mtf_aligner.py:177 — 先读 data 层 fetcher 确认时间戳语义；若 bar-open，reindex+ffill 前加 .shift(1) 或用 searchsorted(side='right') as-of merge

issue_history.note: Extracted from analysis ANL-001 residual_risks

P1-verify parity guard landed (tests/unit/test_strategies.py::TestSignalParityGuard). Per-bar incremental (_latest_signal) vs vectorized (generate_signals) across 5 seeds (42/7/123/2024/99): ENTRY signal 0 drift (5/5 seeds green) — P1-verify F3 foundation solid. EXIT signal systematic drift (12..22 of 122 bars/seed) — root cause located: _latest_signal exit uses (trend_down + rsi_ok_short + atr_ok) without vol_ok, threshold max(min_conditions-1,2); generate_signals exits uses (trend_down + rsi_ok_short + vol_ok + atr_ok) threshold min_conditions, then OR profit_exits|trailing_exits. Two exit-path semantics diverge by design (comment '# exit without vol_ok'). Exit drift recorded as known item in test_exit_signal_drift_is_known_and_bounded (band 1..30), NOT fixed in P1-verify (out of scope, would perturb P1 byte-for-byte regression guard). Awaits ISS-006 semantic decision: unify exit to one semantics, then upgrade guard to strict parity.

EXIT drift ROOT CAUSE FIXED (commit pending): generate_signals exit now mirrors _latest_signal — exit_count = trend_down + rsi_ok_short + atr_ok (NO vol_ok), threshold max(min_conditions-1, 2). Previously used short_count (with vol_ok, threshold min_conditions), violating the documented '# exit without vol_ok' design intent. Parity guard test_exit_residual_is_profit_trailing_role_difference confirms: condition-exit drift eliminated; residual 1..16/122 is a ROLE difference (generate_signals.exits = condition|profit|trailing vs _latest_signal = condition-only; profit/trailing handled by on_bar's _check_position_exits), all one-sided (inc=False,vec=True) shape. 1428 tests pass, zero regression. DEEPER gap found (registered as parity-guard-pending, NOT a fix in this scope): on_bar applies regime gating (engine skips strategy.on_bar when required_regime != detected regime via ADX>=25), but generate_signals does NOT. On real BTC/USDT 1h, ALL 84 generate_signals entries fall on non-trending bars → on_bar gates them all → backtest trades 84x, live trades 0x. Root: trend_following entry uses MA direction (fast>slow & MACD>0), regime uses ADX strength — direction != strength. Guard TestRegimeParityGap quantifies the gap. Design conflict, not a bug — regime gating is execution-layer; mixing into generate_signals breaks its stateless research-API contract. Awaits human decision on regime-vs-entry alignment.
Closed via manage-issue: exit drift root cause fixed (0dbee17); regime gap -> ISS-20260720-001

resolution: 已修复 exit 漂移根因（commit 0dbee17）：generate_signals exit 此前用 short_count（含 vol_ok + 阈值 min_conditions），与 _latest_signal 的 exit_count（无 vol_ok + 阈值 min_conditions-1）不一致，违反 '# exit without vol_ok' 设计意图。对齐为无 vol_ok + 阈值 min_conditions-1。parity 守卫 test_exit_residual_is_profit_trailing_role_difference 确认条件 exit 漂移消除（12..22→1..16），残留单向 shape = profit/trailing 合并职责差异非 bug。注：regime 维度更深 parity 缺口（on_bar 应用 ADX regime gating 而 generate_signals 不应用）另建 ISS-20260720-001 跟踪，不属本 issue exit 范畴。本 issue 原始诉求（增量 vs 向量化信号漂移）的 exit 部分已闭环。

title: parametric-normal VaR 低估 crypto 肥尾，ES_97.5 应提为主指标
description: risk_metrics.py:25,37-42 的 parametric 分支用 mu - sigma*norm.ppf(confidence)，纯高斯——正是论文批评的薄尾方法，crypto 收益尖峰厚尾会系统性低估尾部风险。已有 conditional_var()(CVaR/ES, risk_metrics.py:49-61)实现，但 risk_engine.py:184-191 的 cvar_95 只在 cvar_limit breach 时 block signal，处于从属地位。应将 ES_97.5(FRTB 自 2019 起替代 99% VaR 的相干风险度量)提升为主指标，parametric VaR 降级，并保留 fat-tail 警示。这是 Hull、McNeil/Frey/Embrechts、Basel FRTB 一致结论。
fix_direction: risk_engine.py:184-191 — 将 ES_97.5 提升为主风险门槛，parametric VaR 降为辅助参考；risk_metrics.py 默认 method 改为 historical/ES

title: regime 维度 parity 缺口——on_bar 应用 regime gating 而 generate_signals 不应用
description: on_bar 事件路径应用 regime gating（engine 在 required_regime != detected regime 时跳过 strategy.on_bar，MarketRegimeDetector 用 ADX>=25 判定 trending），而 generate_signals 向量化路径不应用 regime gating——两路径在 regime 维度不 parity。实测真实 BTC/USDT 1h：generate_signals 的 84 个 entries 全部落在非 trending bar → on_bar 全 gate → 回测交易 84 次、实盘 0 次。根因：trend_following entry 用 MA 方向（fast>slow & MACD>0），regime 用 ADX 强度——direction != strength，判定器不一致。比 ISS-20260613-006 exit 漂移更结构性。属设计冲突非 bug（regime gating 是执行层决策，混入 generate_signals 破坏其无状态研究 API 契约）。守卫 TestRegimeParityGap 量化固化缺口，待人裁决 regime↔entry 对齐方向。
fix_direction: 待人裁决三选一：(a) 改 regime 判定器与 entry 条件对齐（用 MA 方向而非 ADX）；(b) 给 trend_following entry 加 ADX 条件对齐 regime；(c) 承认设计特性，generate_signals 文档标注不含 regime gate。裁决前 TestRegimeParityGap 守卫防止缺口无声恶化。

title: ml_ensemble _apply_meta_filter except→approve-all disables meta-labeling filter
description: quantflow/strategy/ai/ml_ensemble.py:377 _apply_meta_filter catches Exception and returns pd.Series(True, ...) approve-all, silently disabling the meta-labeling risk filter when the meta-model raises. Same root-cause family as CORR-H6 DSR except→0.0 (fixed): the error path returns a value indistinguishable from a genuine 'approve' result. Meta-model failure (OOM, shape mismatch, missing feature) thus lets every signal through unfiltered. Fix must define what the meta-label gate does when the model is unavailable: fail-closed (reject all, force NO-GO) is the safe posture, or return a NaN sentinel and exclude from the ensemble aggregation. Requires semantic decision + test encoding the new contract.
fix_direction: Replace the approve-all fallback with fail-closed (pd.Series(False) reject-all) or a NaN sentinel excluded from aggregation; add test for meta-model-exception path.
context: odyssey-review S_GENERALIZE semantic agent finding RC1; pattern RP1

title: PaperGateway cancel_order/cancel_all_orders lack validate_symbol (asymmetric choke point)
description: quantflow/execution/paper_gateway.py:121 cancel_order and cancel_all_orders do not call validate_symbol, while send_order does (fixed in this review). Paper cancel is a no-op so the immediate impact is low, but it violates the 'validate at every gateway entry' spec and would become real if cancel grows logic. Apply validate_symbol/validate_quantity symmetrically across ALL gateway methods (send/cancel/cancel_all) on both OKX and Paper.
fix_direction: Add validate_symbol at the top of PaperGateway.cancel_order and cancel_all_orders, mirroring send_order; mirror in okx_gateway if absent.

title: strategy/engine.py L3 直接 import monitoring/L6 — 违反事件驱动 L6 契约 (H1 NEW)
description: TradingSession 直接调 update_portfolio_metrics/SIGNALS_GENERATED.inc/BAR_PROCESSING_LATENCY.observe/AlertManager.send 直连 L6，违反 CLAUDE.md 事件驱动 L6 契约（L6 应订阅 EventBus 反应式发指标/告警）。L3 持有具体 L6 类。
fix_direction: 将所有 monitoring 调用移到 L6 subscriber，注册到 EventBus (EVENT_BAR/SIGNAL/RISK/ORDER/FILL)；TradingSession 只 publish 事件+调 L4/L5，不 import monitoring/。若同步指标推送不可避免（延迟直方图），在 common/ 暴露薄 Protocol 注入而非 import 具体 L6 类。

feedback.content: Diagnosis (odyssey-review goal follow-up 2026-07-24): strategy/engine uses a HYBRID pattern — already EventBus-decoupled for some flows (subscribe EVENT_RISK line 127; publish events lines 181/305/324) BUT directly imports monitoring/ for: AlertManager (line 25, instantiated 140), SIGNALS_GENERATED.inc (337), update_portfolio_metrics (429), BAR_PROCESSING_LATENCY.observe (438). Full fix requires: (1) define EVENT_PORTFOLIO_UPDATE/EVENT_SIGNAL_GENERATED/EVENT_BAR_PROCESSED; (2) monitoring-layer subscriber subscribes these, calls metrics internally; (3) strategy/engine removes monitoring import, publishes events instead. HIGH RISK: touches TradingSession data-loop hot path + AlertManager lifecycle + metrics timing. Needs full odyssey-improve flow with integration tests. Same pattern at 3 sibling sites (risk_engine:90 lazy-import, execution/kill_switch:10, execution/engine:24) — fix all 4 together in one architecture pass. Deferred to dedicated odyssey-improve quantflow/strategy/engine session.

Implemented fix_direction option B (Protocol injection): common/monitoring_sink.py MonitoringSink Protocol + NullMonitoringSink; monitoring/sink.py DefaultMonitoringSink (owns AlertManager + idempotent metrics start); TradingSession takes monitoring_sink param, default Null. cli/main + web/session_manager inject create_default_sink(). Engine drops all monitoring/ imports; AlertManager lifecycle moved into sink.start. Sibling sites (risk_engine lazy-import, kill_switch, execution/engine) tracked as separate ISS, not in this commit.
